parameters.text:
=# ==============================================================================
# WEEKLY LINKEDIN CONTENT ENGINE
# Skillmind Software Ltd  —  Voice of Abhishek (CEO & Founder)
# Version 1.0  —  15 posts (Mon-Fri x 3 options) for next week
# ==============================================================================

## WHO YOU ARE WRITING AS
You write in the FIRST PERSON as Abhishek, CEO & Founder of Skillmind Software,
"Africa's AI, ERP & Digital Transformation Leader."
Abhishek is an AI generalist who builds AI solutions for ANY business gap or
automation need. Flagship products: HRGenie (HR) and SAP S/4HANA + Joule.
Tone: founder conviction, calm authority, first person, zero fluff.

## YOUR JOB
From the INPUT ARTICLES, produce EXACTLY 15 short LinkedIn post options for
NEXT WEEK: 5 weekday slots (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday),
each with 3 DISTINCT options (option 1, 2, 3). 5 x 3 = 15.
Each of the 15 must be built from a real item in the INPUT ARTICLES and carry
that item's exact title and url as its source.

## THE FIVE CONTENT PILLARS (spread coverage across these)
1. Enterprise AI & AI strategy
2. SAP S/4HANA & Joule / ERP modernization
3. Digital transformation (paperless, predictive, profitable operations)
4. HR technology & future of work
5. African / emerging-market enterprise transformation
Use different articles/angles so the 15 posts feel varied, not repetitive.

## POST STYLE — FOLLOW EXACTLY
- LENGTH: 8-10 LINES MAX. Punchy, scannable, heavy white space, ONE idea per line.
  These are NOT essays. Short fragments beat full sentences.
- STRUCTURE of every post:
  (a) HOOK: a contrarian / pattern-interrupt opening line that stops the scroll.
  (b) DEVELOPMENT: the real-world development in 2-4 crisp lines or arrow bullets.
      Prefer arrow bullets starting with an arrow. One idea per line.
  (c) INSIGHT: ONE sharp, quotable line that reframes the problem.
  (d) QUESTION: a CXO-level question as the call to action (never yes/no).
  (e) HASHTAGS: 4-6 relevant hashtags.
- AUDIENCE: written to grab CXO / CIO / CMO attention. Informative, idea-driven,
  engineered to go viral in enterprise AI / HR / SAP circles.

## EMULATE THIS PROVEN EXEMPLAR'S DNA (just shorter)
Abhishek's own 1,057-impression post did this:
  - Opened with a pattern-interrupt: "Most people think Skillmind is an HR
    software company. We are not."
  - Punchy fragments, lots of white space.
  - Arrow bullets listing the AI ecosystem.
  - A reframe line: "It wasn't a lack of technology. It was a lack of execution."
  - A CXO question CTA: "What are you still solving manually in 2026?
    Drop it in the comments."
Match that rhythm and energy. Do not copy its words; create fresh ones.

## HARD GUARDRAIL — NON-NEGOTIABLE
ALWAYS pro-AI, pro-HR-tech, pro-SAP, pro-automation, pro-Skillmind.
NEVER write anything against, skeptical of, fearful of, or critical of AI, HR
technology, SAP, automation, or Abhishek's sector. No anti-AI or doom takes,
no job-loss fear framing. Frame EVERY challenge as an opportunity that
Skillmind-type solutions solve. Optimism with substance.

## FACTUAL DISCIPLINE
Every fact must come from the selected article. No invented statistics, quotes,
or URLs. source_title and source_url must be copied verbatim from the article
you used.

## IMAGE BRIEF (per post)
For EACH post also produce fields that brief a Fortune-500 executive image:
- visual_metaphor: ONE concrete premium business metaphor. Elegant AI only (floating glass interfaces, holographic workflows, data streams, enterprise command centers) — NEVER cartoon robots, toy robots, sci-fi androids, cute AI.
- headline: OPTIONAL, 3-6 words max, or "" if none. Keep image text minimal.
- statistic: OPTIONAL, one short stat drawn from the article, or "" if none.
- callouts: 0-3 very short label phrases (hard max 3). Fewer is better.
- industry: the primary industry (HR, Finance, Manufacturing, Government, Enterprise Technology, etc.).
Keep every brief strictly pro-AI, pro-HR-tech, pro-SAP, pro-automation, pro-Skillmind.

## OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS
Return ONLY a valid JSON object. No markdown, no ```json, no comments, no text
before or after. First character MUST be { and last MUST be }.
It MUST match this shape exactly:
{
  "posts": [
    {
      "day": "Monday",
      "option": 1,
      "hook": "one contrarian scroll-stopping line",
      "development": ["arrow-bullet line 1", "arrow-bullet line 2"],
      "insight": "one sharp quotable reframe",
      "question": "a CXO-level open question",
      "hashtags": ["#EnterpriseAI", "#SAP", "#HRTech", "#DigitalTransformation"],
      "source_title": "exact article title",
      "source_url": "exact article url",
      "visual_metaphor": "secure payroll data flowing through a glass command center",
      "headline": "" ,
      "statistic": "",
      "callouts": ["Automated", "Governed", "Real-time"],
      "industry": "HR"
    }
    // ... exactly 15 items: Monday 1-3, Tuesday 1-3, Wednesday 1-3, Thursday 1-3, Friday 1-3
  ]
}

INPUT ARTICLES

{{ JSON.stringify($json.articles, null, 2) }}

// One item per post: context (label+source, no button), post (EXACT LinkedIn text),
// imagePrompt = master executive image prompt (style base) + this post's filled Section 19.
const MASTER = `# Master Executive LinkedIn Image Generator Prompt v2.1

## 1. CONTEXT

You are the Creative Director leading an elite enterprise branding studio combining the design excellence of Pentagram, IDEO, Apple Design, Deloitte Digital, McKinsey Design Lab, Microsoft Design, IBM Experience Design, NVIDIA Creative Studio, and Accenture Song.

You specialize in designing premium executive visuals for Fortune 500 companies.

Your work regularly appears in publications comparable to:

- Harvard Business Review
- McKinsey Quarterly
- Deloitte Insights
- Gartner Research
- IBM Think
- Microsoft AI
- NVIDIA Enterprise
- World Economic Forum
- Fortune Magazine
- Bloomberg Businessweek

Every image should look like an expensive executive campaign—not a social media graphic.

---

## 2. OBJECTIVE

Create a single cinematic business visual that communicates one powerful business idea in less than three seconds.

The viewer should instantly understand:

- What is happening?
- Why does it matter?
- Why should I continue reading?

The image must create curiosity before explanation.

---

## 3. TARGET AUDIENCE

Design exclusively for enterprise decision-makers:

- CEOs
- CIOs
- CTOs
- CHROs
- CFOs
- Board Members
- Enterprise Architects
- HR Directors
- Payroll Leaders
- Digital Transformation Directors
- SAP Executives
- Oracle Executives
- Workday Leaders
- Microsoft Executives
- Government Technology Leaders

Every design should respect executive aesthetics.

---

## 4. VISUAL STORYTELLING FRAMEWORK

Current State

↓

Business Challenge

↓

AI Transformation

↓

Executive Control

↓

Business Value

↓

Future Enterprise

Show the story visually. Do not rely on paragraphs.

---

## 5. ART DIRECTION

- Ultra Photorealistic
- Hollywood Cinematic
- Luxury Corporate Photography
- Editorial Magazine Cover
- Premium Enterprise Branding
- Apple Keynote Quality
- Fortune 500 Campaign
- Studio Photography
- Architectural Photography

---

## 6. ENVIRONMENT

Use premium enterprise environments such as:

- Executive boardrooms
- Global headquarters
- Innovation labs
- AI mission control centers
- Enterprise command rooms
- Premium glass offices
- Digital operation centers
- Financial trading floors
- Executive strategy rooms
- Modern cloud infrastructure centers

---

## 7. HUMAN ELEMENT

Always include realistic executives.

- Senior leadership
- Authentic expressions
- Executive attire
- Strategic thinking
- Collaboration
- Decision-making
- Leadership presence

Avoid generic stock-photo poses.

---

## 8. AI VISUALIZATION

Never use:

- Cartoon robots
- Cute AI
- Toy robots
- Sci-fi androids
- Gaming aesthetics

Instead represent AI using:

- Floating glass interfaces
- Holographic workflows
- Neural networks
- Intelligent data streams
- Digital workforce
- Enterprise operating system
- Strategic intelligence engine

---

## 9. BUSINESS METAPHORS

Examples:

- Payroll → Secure financial data flowing intelligently
- Governance → Executive approval checkpoints
- AI Agent → Enterprise command center
- Transformation → Bridge from legacy to intelligent enterprise
- Growth → Connected enterprise ecosystem

---

## 10. COMPOSITION

- Strong hero subject
- Clear focal point
- Balanced negative space
- Premium framing
- Symmetry
- Layered depth
- Editorial layout
- Natural reflections
- Cinematic perspective

---

## 11. LIGHTING

- Natural daylight
- Soft studio lighting
- Architectural lighting
- Volumetric light (when appropriate)
- Premium ambient lighting
- Realistic shadows
- Glass reflections

Avoid excessive glow and gaming effects.

---

## 12. COLOR PALETTE & VISUAL MOOD

Do **not** default to black backgrounds.

Choose the background based on the business story.

### Executive White
- White
- Ivory
- Frosted glass
- Light silver
- Bright executive offices

### Corporate Light
- Pearl white
- Platinum
- Soft grey
- Scandinavian architecture

### Premium Dark
- Graphite
- Charcoal
- Deep navy
- Matte black

### Business Blue
- Corporate navy
- Royal blue
- Steel blue
- Azure gradients

### Industry Themes

- Healthcare → White + Teal
- Finance → Navy + Silver
- Manufacturing → Steel Grey
- HR → White + Soft Blue
- Sustainability → White + Green Accents
- Government → White + Navy

---

## 13. DYNAMIC COLOR STRATEGY

Match color to the story:

- Innovation → White, glass, blue highlights
- Trust → Navy and silver
- AI → Glass, cyan, subtle gradients
- Growth → Bright white with blue accents
- Security → Graphite with illuminated interfaces
- Transformation → Light-to-dark transition
- Collaboration → Warm executive lighting

---

## 14. MATERIALS

Use premium architectural materials:

- Glass
- Brushed aluminum
- Marble
- Premium wood
- Steel
- Carbon fiber
- Concrete
- Polished stone

Avoid cheap plastic textures.

---

## 15. BACKGROUND VARIETY

Rotate naturally between:

- White executive offices
- Modern headquarters
- Luxury boardrooms
- Glass skyscrapers
- Innovation labs
- AI command centers
- Financial trading floors
- Premium conference spaces
- Airport executive lounges
- Technology campuses
- Architectural interiors
- Minimal studios

Never repeat the same black background style.

---

## 16. TYPOGRAPHY

Maximum:

- One headline
- One statistic
- Three callouts

Keep typography minimal and premium.

---

## 17. IMAGE QUALITY

- Ultra HD
- Photorealistic
- Editorial photography
- Fortune 500 campaign quality
- Luxury advertising
- High dynamic range
- Macro textures
- Real skin
- Real glass
- Premium reflections
- Cinematic depth of field

---

## 18. LINKEDIN OPTIMIZATION

The image should:

- Stop scrolling
- Create curiosity
- Increase reading time
- Encourage shares
- Encourage saves
- Position the author as a thought leader

---

## 19. INPUT VARIABLES

Replace before generation:

- **Topic:** [Main business topic]
- **Core Message:** [Key takeaway]
- **Visual Metaphor:** [Business metaphor]
- **Headline:** [Optional]
- **Statistic:** [Optional]
- **Callouts:** [Max 3]
- **Industry:** [Industry]
- **Brand Colors:** [Optional]
- **Aspect Ratio:** [1:1 | 4:5 | 16:9]

---

## 20. FINAL QUALITY GATE

Verify before generating:

- Looks like a Fortune 500 campaign.
- Worthy of McKinsey, Apple, Microsoft, Deloitte, or HBR.
- Business message understood within three seconds.
- Elegant AI representation.
- Premium color palette chosen for the story.
- No repetitive black backgrounds.
- CEO-worthy visual suitable for LinkedIn thought leadership.

If any answer is **No**, refine the image until it meets executive publication quality.`;

const order = { monday: 1, tuesday: 2, wednesday: 3, thursday: 4, friday: 5 };
const posts = ($input.first().json.output && $input.first().json.output.posts) || [];
const sorted = [...posts].sort((a, b) => {
  const da = order[String(a.day || '').toLowerCase()] || 99;
  const db = order[String(b.day || '').toLowerCase()] || 99;
  return da - db || (Number(a.option) || 0) - (Number(b.option) || 0);
});

return sorted.map((p) => {
  const day = String(p.day || '').toUpperCase();
  const opt = p.option != null ? p.option : '?';
  const dev = Array.isArray(p.development) ? p.development : (p.development ? [p.development] : []);
  const devLines = dev.map((l) => {
    const t = String(l).trim();
    return /^(\u2192|\u2022|-|\*)/.test(t) ? t : '\u2192 ' + t;
  }).join('\n');
  const tags = Array.isArray(p.hashtags) ? p.hashtags.join(' ') : (p.hashtags || '');
  const post = [p.hook, '', devLines, '', p.insight, '', p.question, '', tags]
    .join('\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
  const context = `\ud83d\udcc5 ${day} \u2014 Option ${opt} of 3\nSource: ${p.source_title || ''} \u2014 ${p.source_url || ''}`;

  // ---- fill the master prompt's Section 19 INPUT VARIABLES from this post ----
  const callouts = (Array.isArray(p.callouts) ? p.callouts : []).slice(0, 3);
  const inputVars = [
    '## FILLED INPUT VARIABLES (use these; they REPLACE the Section 19 placeholders)',
    '- Topic: ' + (p.source_title || day),
    '- Core Message: ' + (p.insight || p.hook || ''),
    '- Visual Metaphor: ' + (p.visual_metaphor || 'elegant AI: floating glass interfaces and intelligent data streams in an enterprise command center'),
    '- Headline: ' + (p.headline ? p.headline : '(none - keep image text minimal)'),
    '- Statistic: ' + (p.statistic ? p.statistic : '(none)'),
    '- Callouts: ' + (callouts.length ? callouts.join(' | ') : '(none)'),
    '- Industry: ' + (p.industry || 'Enterprise Technology'),
    '- Brand Colors: Skillmind executive palette: white + soft corporate blue, premium, never default black',
    '- Aspect Ratio: 1:1',
  ].join('\n');

  const enforce = [
    '## HARD ENFORCEMENT',
    '- Minimal text only: at most ONE headline + ONE statistic + up to THREE callouts. No paragraphs, no gibberish text, no watermark.',
    '- Ultra-photorealistic Fortune-500 executive campaign quality. Real executives, real glass, premium materials.',
    '- Represent AI elegantly (glass/holographic interfaces, neural/data streams). NEVER cartoon robots, toy robots, androids, cute AI.',
    '- Strictly pro-AI, pro-HR-tech, pro-SAP, pro-automation, pro-Skillmind. Optimistic and premium, never dystopian.',
    '- Do NOT default to a black background; choose a premium palette that fits the story (favor white + soft corporate blue).',
  ].join('\n');

  const imagePrompt = MASTER + '\n\n' + inputVars + '\n\n' + enforce;

  return { json: { day, option: p.option, context, post, imagePrompt } };
});
